credentials_info: Instead of a token, the adapter can also sign in with the username and password of a Music Assistant user. A token is tried first.
docker_credentials_info: On the first start the adapter creates this user as administrator in Music Assistant and signs in with it. Log in with the same credentials at http://<ioBroker-host>:8095 (or the "Music Assistant" tile on the intro page) to finish the setup. Changing them here later does not change the user in Music Assistant.
docker_explanation: ioBroker starts and manages the Music Assistant server in a Docker container on this host. Docker must be installed.
If enabled, the latest Docker image will: If enabled, the latest Docker image will be pulled when the adapter starts.
Long-lived token from Settings → Profile: Long-lived token from Settings → Profile on the Music Assistant server
